metadata.title: Zoho Recruit Integration — Civify
metadata.description: Seamlessly integrate Civify with Zoho Recruit to automatically parse CVs, generate summaries, and assess candidates directly inside your ATS.
metadata.ogDescription: Automate resume screening and assessment right inside your Zoho Recruit dashboard.

hero.title: Supercharge Your ATS
hero.subtitle: Bring the power of Civify directly into Zoho Recruit. Mask resumes With one Click.

features.title: Recruitment Made Brilliant
features.subtitle: Discover how the Civify extension enhances your Zoho Recruit workflow.

parse.title: Instant CV Parsing
parse.description: Automatically extract skills, experience, and contact details from any uploaded resume right into Zoho candidate fields.

summarize.title: AI Summaries
summarize.description: Generate concise, executive-level summaries for each candidate's background and core competencies.

assess.title: Candidate Assessment
assess.description: Get an immediate AI evaluation of a candidate's fit for the job listing, highlighting matches and skill gaps.

howItWorks.title: Set Up in Minutes
howItWorks.subtitle: Integrating Civify with Zoho Recruit is simple and fast.

step1.title: Install on Zoho
step1.description: Visit the Zoho Marketplace and install the Civify app into your Zoho Recruit account.

step2.title: Get API Key
step2.description: Log into your Civify account, navigate to API Keys, and generate a new key.

step3.title: Connect
step3.description: Paste your Civify API key into the Zoho Recruit extension settings page to authenticate.

step4.title: Start Masking
step4.description: Open any candidate record in Zoho Recruit and click the Civify button to mask immediately.

tutorial.title: Experience It Live
tutorial.subtitle: Watch how to install and use the Civify extension within Zoho Recruit to streamline your hiring.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Learn more about the Civify integration for Zoho Recruit.

q1.question: Does it work with existing candidates in Zoho Recruit?
q1.answer: Yes! You can use the Civify extension to parse and evaluate both newly added candidates and the ones already existing in your database.

q2.question: Do I need a paid Civify account?
q2.answer: The Zoho extension requires an active Civify API key. Free accounts are provided with a quota, but heavy usage requires a premium plan.

q3.question: Is candidate data kept secure?
q3.answer: Absolutely. Data is processed securely according to our Privacy Policy and is used only for the purpose of generating the parsing and assessment results you request.

cta.title: Ready to Modernize Your Hiring?
cta.subtitle: Install the Civify extension on Zoho Recruit today and never manually parse a resume again.
